model.name: Maex and De Schutter 1998 cerebellar Golgi cell (Golgi_98)
model.citation: Maex R, De Schutter E (1998). Synchronization of Golgi and Granule Cell Firing in a Detailed Network Model of the Cerebellar Granule Cell Layer. Journal of Neurophysiology 80(5):2521-2537. doi:10.1152/jn.1998.80.5.2521
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment (30 um); NaF, KDr, KA, KCa, CaHVA (Nernst), H, Ca pool. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): spontaneous pacemaking ~7 Hz (ISI CV 0.002); strong spike-frequency adaptation under depolarisation (ISI last/first 3.3 at +0.2 nA, 3.5 at +0.15 nA 2 s); 3-4 rebound spikes after hyperpolarisation. Sag ratio undefined (spike in the pre-step baseline window). At -0.1 nA V recovers 12.5 mV from its late trough; with Ih blocked there is no recovery and V ends at -162 mV instead of -75 mV, so Ih strongly limits hyperpolarisation. Ih-block runs at -0.2 and -0.3 nA aborted in jLEMS.
model.inclusion_reason: Recommended candidate for the independent-source adapting model. Ih is functionally large in the block control but a sag ratio is not established. Decisions needed: no single-cell harness shipped; spontaneous activity makes rheobase normalisation fall back to 0.1 nA. Same family as maex1998_granule.
